summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of new ClickUp-style Kanban implementation (KanbanBoard, BoardView, ListView, CalendarView, DashboardView, TaskDetail, TaskModal). All 13 backend pytest cases pass (login all roles, default statuses, column CRUD with dev 403, task create/patch/drag/invalid-status/due_date null, developer scope 403, comments incl. client, timer toggle + manual time entries + delete, bulk update/delete, stats, feature<->task sync, ticket->task sync incl. delete on Ditolak, backfill sources). Frontend flows all functional: barong image large (780x864 on login), sidebar has no nav-kanban, /kanban redirects to /projects, project-1 Kanban tab shows all 5 default columns, all 4 view switchers, all filters, quick add creates task, task drawer shows all controls (status/priority/tag/subtask/comment/timer/manual time/close), comment send OK, timer toggle produces total time, List view has select-task-*, bulk-bar with bulk-priority, row-status-*, Calendar view exposes cal-month/prev/next and cal-day-* cells, Dashboard shows kpi-0..5 and workload-table, add-column creates new column (slug test_newcol) and column-delete removes it, add-task modal with field-title/field-status/field-tags/save-button creates task and opens drawer. As developer role: add-task and add-column hidden, nav-kanban absent, status change on assigned task succeeds.

ui_bugs.issue: Timer element text concatenates duration with button label ('1dMulai') suggesting missing whitespace between task-timer display and adjacent element. Visual only.

action_items: Optional: check spacing between task-timer duration and adjacent Mulai/Stop button label in TaskDetail (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: kanban.py delete_status uses query param `move_to` but no validation-if provided name doesn't match, silently falls back to rest[0]['name']. Consider 400 on invalid move_to.
kanban.py enrich() runs a projects.find with limit 2000 per call-fine for now but scale could bite; consider caching within request.
toggle_timer forces min 1 second (max(1, int(...))); acceptable for UX but be aware very-fast toggles will not accumulate zero.
sync_source has FEATURE_TO_TASK-style mapping duplicated between projects.py and kanban.py; consider centralizing.
seed_data_creation: Test tasks were auto-created and cleaned up. Some TEST_modal_task / TEST_quick_add_task may remain in project-1 from frontend tests (no cleanup implemented in UI runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kanban.py (13 tests). Use pytest tests/test_kanban.py. Login helper uses captcha-input placeholder='Jawaban' and input[name=username|password]. Kanban tab exposes all specced data-testids. Frontend leaves stray TEST_ tasks on project-1; consider adding cleanup in future runs.
